actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.
actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.
actions.name: reset_world

actions.description: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.
actions.name: set_seed

facts.text: RoboCasa is a large-scale simulation framework for training robots to perform everyday tasks, not a hardware SDK
The documented entry point creates an environment with gym.make('robocasa/PickPlaceCounterToCabinet', split='pretrain', seed=0)
The wrapper registers every environment as 'robocasa/<class>' with the wrapper class as the entry point
RoboCasaGymEnv is a gymnasium.Env subclass
RoboCasaGymEnv forwards unknown attributes to the inner robosuite environment through __getattr__

The wrapper's action space is a Dict of five Box fields with low -1 and high 1: action.gripper_close (1 element), action.end_effector_position (3), action.end_effector_rotation (3), action.base_motion (4) and action.control_mode (1)
The final action_space is PandaOmronKeyConverter.deduce_action_space(env), not the space built from the composite controller

unmap_action reads the five fields as input_action['action.gripper_close'], ['action.end_effector_position'], ['action.end_effector_rotation'], ['action.base_motion'] and ['action.control_mode'] before calling the inner environment
The wrapper maps the robot observation to state.gripper_qpos, state.base_position, state.base_rotation, state.end_effector_position_relative and state.end_effector_rotation_relative
The mapped state observations are Box(-1, 1)
The camera configuration is three views named robot0_agentview_left, robot0_agentview_right and robot0_eye_in_hand, all 256 by 256 pixels
The observation space adds one Box(0, 255) of shape (height, width, 3) per video.* camera and a Text(max_length=256) annotation.human.task_description
reset(seed) replaces the inner environment RNG with numpy.random.default_rng(seed); options is accepted but not used
step calls the inner environment, reports reward 1.0 when _check_success() is true and 0.0 otherwise, always sets truncated False and returns the inner environment's done flag
Kitchen passes control_freq 20, horizon 1000 and ignore_done True to robosuite; one control signal therefore advances the simulation by 50 ms
Kitchen._check_success returns False by default and the task subclasses implement the success test
The package pins MuJoCo 3.3.1 and asserts that version at import
Each environment is built with robosuite.make, the MuJoCo-backed engine
The kitchen assets downloaded by the setup script are around 10GB
render returns the cached camera frame and refuses before a reset or step; close delegates to the inner environment

determinism.notes: the driver records a seed and passes it to reset(seed), which replaces the wrapper's inner numpy generator (gym_wrapper.py:342-344); the fake draws its placeholder state with Python's random.Random, so one seed repeats on the fake but gives a different trajectory than the upstream numpy stream, and no trajectory of the two was compared

gaps: no dynamics: the fake integrates a placeholder linear motion of the robot state and has no MuJoCo, robosuite, rigid-body, contact, friction, actuator, sensor or noise model; the upstream wrapper would be an F1 MuJoCo model (robocasa/__init__.py:1005-1007, robocasa/utils/env_utils.py:138), not this
the fake keeps reward 0.0 and done False for the base Kitchen success test (kitchen.py:1542-1551); the concrete task's success test, reward and horizon behaviour are not modelled
the fake returns 2x2x3 placeholder camera frames whereas the upstream observation space declares 256x256x3 frames (gym_wrapper.py:244-250), and its state lengths are placeholders
task scenes and objects need the roughly 10GB kitchen assets downloaded by the setup script (README.md:65), which were not installed or downloaded here
snapshot and restore are not offered: RoboCasaGymEnv exposes no get_state/set_state pair
no sim or hardware backend is declared; the real wrapper path needs robocasa imported to register the id, robosuite, MuJoCo 3.3.1 (setup.py:21) and the kitchen assets, and was not run
no physical device is modelled and the simulator was never validated against one

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: the e-stop closes the wrapper and no step or reset is accepted until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch and reopens it at the recorded seed; the observation and tick stay readable
